text: DSH LeRobot Dataset Inspector 为 DSH 注册 lerobot_inspect_dataset 工具，通过 profile 文件系统检查本地 LeRobot 数据集。提供版本、特征、统计、任务、回合长度及数据和视频文件数量摘要；可按 episode_index 查看单个回合详情。需要提供数据集目录，不需 API 密钥或外部服务；受限扫描可能返回不完整结果。

DSH LeRobot Dataset Inspector adds lerobot_inspect_dataset to DSH. It summarizes local dataset metadata, features, tasks, episodes, statistics, and asset counts; an episode index adds one episode’s details. It uses the profile filesystem and requires no API key or external service.
想快速查看一个 LeRobot 数据集包含哪些任务、回合和特征。
能不能给我某个 episode 的长度、任务和统计摘要？
I need a quick summary of a local LeRobot dataset, including its tasks, episodes, and asset counts.
DSH LeRobot Dataset Inspector 的功能「数据集概览」：调用工具并传入目录，查看元数据、任务、回合、特征统计及资产计数。
DSH LeRobot Dataset Inspector 的功能「回合详情」：传入 episode_index，查看该回合长度、任务、索引范围和可用统计。

dsh-lerobot-dataset-inspector README · Summary：Add `lerobot_inspect_dataset` to a profile to inspect a local LeRobot dataset. It summarizes metadata, features, statistics, tasks, episodes, and asset counts, with optional details for one episode. The plugin reads through the active DSH filesystem and does not open robot data Parquet files or decode video frames.

dsh-lerobot-dataset-inspector README · Table of Contents：- [Use this package](#use-this-package) - [Understand the implementation](#understand-the-implementation) - [Further Exploration](#further-exploration) - [Model Experience](#model-experience) - [Known Limitations and Deferred Work](#known-limitations-and-deferred-work) - [Dev Note](#dev-note) -----

dsh-lerobot-dataset-inspector README · Install into a profile：From a DSH checkout or installed DSH CLI, add this local bundle to a profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /absolute/path/to/lerobot-dataset-inspector
dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove dsh-lerobot-dataset-inspector
```

Start DSH with that profile, then call `lerobot_inspect_dataset` with a dataset directory visible to its filesystem. Removing the package removes its profile layer.

dsh-lerobot-dataset-inspector README · What you get：The tool returns LeRobot version and counts, feature shapes, available aggregate statistics, task names, episode-length summaries, and data/video file counts. Pass `episode_index` to include that episode's metadata and, for v3.0, its per-episode statistics.

The tool reads metadata and episode/task manifests through `ctx.fs`. It does not open data Parquet files or read or decode MP4 contents. Every path remains subject to the active profile's filesystem permissions.

dsh-lerobot-dataset-inspector README · Run the tests：The tests use small metadata files and Parquet fixtures. They do not access robot datasets or network services. ```sh pnpm install --ignore-workspace --ignore-scripts node --test tests/inspector.test.mjs node --experimental-test-coverage --test tests/inspector.test.mjs ``` The package requires Node.js 24.9 or newer and DSH `>=0.2.2-alpha.2 <0.3.0`. -----

dsh-lerobot-dataset-inspector README · Understand the implementation：<details>
<summary>Implementation details — click to expand</summary>

The bundle patch inserts one Cordis plugin row. The plugin resolves dataset paths through the profile filesystem, reads only metadata and episode/task manifests, and applies bounded file, row, byte, and directory-depth scans. When a scan reaches a limit, the result reports incomplete data and lower-bound counts.

dsh-lerobot-dataset-inspector README · Understand the implementation：The patch and source map are [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml), [`src/index.mjs`](src/index.mjs), and [`src/inspect.mjs`](src/inspect.mjs). Parquet parsing uses the pinned `hyparquet` dependency. -----

dsh-lerobot-dataset-inspector README · Further Exploration：See the [DeepSeek Harness contribution guide](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) for ways to share independent plugins and participate in the community. -----

dsh-lerobot-dataset-inspector README · Model Experience：The tool returns structured metadata and bounded summaries. It does not expose robot frame contents or decoded video to the model; one requested v3.0 episode may include its stored per-episode statistics.

dsh-lerobot-dataset-inspector README · KV Cache impact：The result size is bounded by feature, task, row, and output limits, though larger metadata summaries use more context than smaller datasets.

-----

dsh-lerobot-dataset-inspector README · Known Limitations and Deferred Work：The inspector does not validate robot frame values or decode video. It reports inventory as incomplete when file, entry, or depth limits prevent a full scan.

dsh-lerobot-dataset-inspector README · Known Limitations and Deferred Work：- **Metadata reads are bounded** — JSON files, JSONL rows, Parquet files, ranges, and total bytes have fixed limits; findings identify incomplete results. - **Vector output is capped** — feature shapes and statistics include at most 16 values, and the result marks truncation as incomplete. - **Episode statistics are per-episode** — v3.0 episode statistics appear only when `episode_index` selects a row that contains them.
